sources: recreation.gov search API (q='Big Eddy'): no Montana listing, read 2026-10-22

values.note: 5 sites with tables and fire rings; two day-use sites (one with a covered shelter) near the boat ramp.

sites.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/big-eddy-campground ('The campground has 5 sites with table and fire rings and will accommodate a 30' RV', 'There is two day use sites'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Fully developed boat ramp with a dock.

facilities.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/big-eddy-campground ('Amenities include vault toilets and a fully developed boat ramp with a dock', 'Potable water is not available at this site.'), read 2026-10-22

values.note: Forest Service: 'The campground is managed from Memorial Day through Labor Day, but is available all year to visitors. Access is dependent upon weather conditions.'
No reservation channel: the Forest Service page offers none and recreation.gov has no listing. 16-day stay limit on National Forest System lands.

booking.source: https://www.fs.usda.gov/r01/kootenai/recreation/big-eddy-campground ('16 day stay limit on National Forest System Lands'; no reservation link) + recreation.gov search API (no Big Eddy facility in Montana), read 2026-10-22

note: Kootenai NF (Cabinet RD) campground on Cabinet Gorge Reservoir (Clark Fork River), ~6 mi E of the Idaho line on Highway 200 near Heron, with a boat ramp and dock. --Claude
summary: Forest Service (Kootenai NF), free, first-come (no reservation channel; not on recreation.gov). Confirmed $0, 5 sites for a 30-ft RV, vault toilets, open all year (managed Memorial Day-Labor Day). Added no potable water, 16-day limit. No current alert names it. Note trimmed of restated values.
